research_findings: The application was susceptible to client-side crashes and infinite loops due to unhandled JSON parsing errors and poorly written localStorage availability checks.

The legacy method for checking localStorage availability (writing a test key) caused the app to incorrectly assume localStorage was disabled when the user merely hit their storage quota, locking them out of recovering or deleting existing data.
Iteration over localStorage keys using a forward loop (i++) caused index skipping bugs whenever corrupted items were identified and dynamically removed.
features_improved: DiagramCanvas: Replaced raw localStorage methods with safe utilities, ensuring robust fallback for corrupted diagram saves.
Free Draw Page: Replaced raw localStorage methods, safeguarding canvas state persistence across unmounts.
TimerWidget: Safely interacts with localStorage for timer persistence.
Session Storage: Refactored getAllSessions and getSessionState to use central generic safe local storage utils. Fixed infinite loop by iterating backwards over the localStorage index.
new_features_added: Local Storage Utilities: Introduced `src/lib/localStorageUtils.ts` containing `safeGetJSON`, `safeSetJSON`, `safeGetString`, and `safeSetString` with granular error handling and automatic corrupted-data eviction.
next_steps_for_next_run: Investigate replacing localStorage for heavily intensive elements (like the Diagram Canvas states) with IndexedDB to mitigate 5MB quota restrictions.
Standardize all error reporting inside localStorageUtils to emit telemetry if an external logging service is added.
